title: Names next to the logo

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Give service names their own readable prominence while keeping ownership visibly connected to the city.
strategic_value: A shared name-setting method can reduce fragmentation without making every Helsinki operator use an identical composition.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section explains operator-name typography, pairs names with framed-logo placements and shows prohibited name treatments.
practical_value: Set an operator’s name with the prescribed type rules, then place it away from the city signature at a suitable size.

content_islands.name: Operator applications

content_islands.name: Incorrect names

ingredient.name: Operator name
ingredient.role: Distinguish a service while retaining visible city ownership.
ingredient.application: Use Helsinki Grotesk Bold or Medium; Black is allowed for names shorter than ten letters. Use initial capitalization, tracking −25, leading 100%, and left-aligned 2–3 lines for multiword names without syllable breaks.
ingredient.scope: No fixed name-to-logo size ratio is specified; matching the Helsinki word’s type size is the recommended minimum. Names always accompany the city logo and must not use light text colors.

reference_purposes.Intent: The name/color guidance explicitly invokes accessibility for avoiding light text.
reference_purposes.Application: Examples show name setting and arrangements with the city mark.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Operators must include the city logo and cannot create their own; specified font, case and spacing rules apply.
